aka.zh: 航海家之路（圣克鲁瓦至圣吕斯）
佩龙大道（加斯佩环线，原 6 号公路）

tagline.en: Quebec's south-shore road: up the St. Lawrence from the New York border to the Gaspé, then all the way round the peninsula
tagline.zh: 魁北克的南岸之路：自纽约州边境沿圣劳伦斯河而下直到加斯佩，再环绕整个半岛

start.en: Dundee, at the New York border near the meeting of Quebec, Ontario and New York
start.zh: 邓迪，位于纽约州边境，靠近魁北克、安大略与纽约州的交界处

end.en: Cap-des-Rosiers by Forillon National Park, the eastern tip of the Gaspé loop as drawn; the route continues round the peninsula and closes the loop at Sainte-Flavie
end.zh: 福里隆国家公园旁的玫瑰角，即图中加斯佩环线的东端；该路继续环绕半岛，在圣弗拉维闭合成环

en: Route 132 runs for some 1,600 km. It starts at the New York border at Dundee and follows the south shore of the St. Lawrence past Montreal's south shore suburbs, Sorel, Lévis and the old seigneurial villages of the Bas-Saint-Laurent, the river widening into an estuary as it goes. At Sainte-Flavie it divides and makes a complete loop of the Gaspé Peninsula, more than 930 km on its own.

The loop is the famous part. The north coast is a narrow shelf between the Chic-Choc Mountains and the sea, the road climbing headlands and dropping into fishing villages; at the tip are Forillon and the rock at Percé; the south coast along the Baie des Chaleurs is gentler farming country facing New Brunswick.

Being a shore road, it is exposed to the sea. Storm surges and coastal erosion repeatedly cut or undermine it on the Gaspé, and the province's coastal adaptation programme now covers more than 200 sites along it and other shore roads.
zh: 132 号公路全长约 1,600 公里。它始于邓迪的纽约州边境，沿圣劳伦斯河南岸经蒙特利尔南岸郊区、索雷尔、莱维以及下圣劳伦斯地区的旧领主制村庄，河面一路展宽为河口湾。在圣弗拉维，它一分为二，完整环绕加斯佩半岛一周，仅此一环即逾 930 公里。
环线是最著名的部分。北岸是希克肖克山脉与大海之间的狭长台地，公路翻上岬角，又下到渔村；半岛顶端是福里隆与佩尔塞巨岩；南岸沿沙勒尔湾而行，是面向新不伦瑞克、较为平缓的农区。
作为一条沿岸公路，它直面大海。风暴潮与海岸侵蚀屡屡在加斯佩冲断或掏空路基；该省的海岸适应计划目前覆盖这条公路及其他沿岸道路上的 200 多处地点。

en: The road round the Gaspé was the Boulevard Perron, named after Joseph-Léonide Perron, the roads minister who championed it. It opened in 1929, and an inaugural tour with Premier Louis-Alexandre Taschereau drove it from 20 to 27 July that year. The road became part of Route 6. According to a local history, Le Devoir called the name ‘boulevard’ for a gravel road round a peninsula the longest mistake in the French language.

The rest of today's route was assembled from older provincial roads, including Routes 2, 3, 6, 9C and 10. In the renumbering of the early 1970s they were joined under the number 132, which reached the Gaspé loop in 1972. Along the river much of it is now paralleled by Autoroute 20, leaving 132 as the local road through the shore towns.

The stretch along the river from Sainte-Croix to Sainte-Luce is signed as the Route des Navigateurs, a tourist route. In Longueuil and Brossard a divided section has carried the name Autoroute René-Lévesque since 2013.
zh: 环绕加斯佩的道路即“佩龙大道”，以力推此路的道路部长约瑟夫-莱奥尼德·佩龙命名。它于 1929 年开通，同年 7 月 20 日至 27 日，省长路易-亚历山大·塔舍罗参加了全程首巡。这条路后来成为 6 号公路的一部分。据一份地方史料，《义务报》曾把一条环绕半岛的砾石路称作“大道”讥为“法语里最长的错误”。
今日路线的其余部分由更早的省道拼合而成，包括 2、3、6、9C 与 10 号公路。在 20 世纪 70 年代初的重新编号中，它们统一编为 132 号，加斯佩环线于 1972 年改用此号。如今沿河的大部分路段都有 20 号高速公路与之平行，132 号公路成为穿过沿岸城镇的地方道路。
圣克鲁瓦至圣吕斯的沿河路段标为旅游路线“航海家之路”。在隆格伊与布罗萨尔，一段分隔路段自 2013 年起名为“勒内-莱维斯克高速公路”。

value.en: 1,612.1 km, as cited in English Wikipedia, Quebec Route 132, from the Ministère des Transports “Distances routières” (2005). The Gaspé loop alone is more than 930 km.
value.zh: 1,612.1 公里，据英文维基百科“魁北克 132 号公路”条目所引魁北克交通部《道路距离》（2005 年）。仅加斯佩环线即逾 930 公里。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Quebec Route 132 (citing Ministère des Transports du Québec, Distances routières, 2005)

value.en: No total published. Reported for the Boulevard Perron at $800,000 from the Colonisation ministry over five years from 1921 and $500,000 from the roads ministry in 1926–29; not checked against Quebec public accounts.
value.zh: 未公布总额。据报道，佩龙大道获殖民部自 1921 年起五年内拨款 80 万加元、道路部 1926—1929 年拨款 50 万加元；未经魁北克公共账目核实。

figures.source: Graffici (Gaspé regional publication), blog article on the history of the Boulevard Perron

value.en: The province, through the Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable. Coastal protection is also provincial: the beach recharge at Maria, more than $17.5 million for 1.4 km (2025), and $4.9 million of sea walls between La Martre and Marsoui (2025).
value.zh: 省政府，经由魁北克交通与可持续出行部。海岸防护亦由省政府出资：马里亚海滩补沙工程逾 1,750 万加元、覆盖 1.4 公里（2025 年），拉马特尔至马尔苏伊之间的海堤 490 万加元（2025 年）。

figures.source: Gouvernement du Québec news release, 1 December 2025; Radio-Canada, August 2025

value.en: 228 coastal sites covered by the provincial programme for adapting roads to coastal hazards (2025).
value.zh: 省级道路海岸灾害适应计划覆盖 228 处沿岸地点（2025 年）。

figures.source: Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs, 2025 report

timeline.en: According to a local history, the Colonisation ministry begins five years of grants for a road round the Gaspé coast.
timeline.zh: 据一份地方史料，殖民部开始为环绕加斯佩海岸的道路提供为期五年的拨款。

timeline.en: The Boulevard Perron round the Gaspé opens; Premier Taschereau's inaugural tour runs from 20 to 27 July.
timeline.zh: 环绕加斯佩的佩龙大道开通；7 月 20 日至 27 日，塔舍罗省长进行全程首巡。

timeline.en: The Gaspé loop is renumbered as Route 132.
timeline.zh: 加斯佩环线改编为 132 号公路。

timeline.en: The divided section in Longueuil and Brossard is named Autoroute René-Lévesque.
timeline.zh: 隆格伊与布罗萨尔的分隔路段定名为“勒内-莱维斯克高速公路”。

timeline.en: The province funds a $17.5 million beach recharge at Maria and new sea walls between La Martre and Marsoui to protect the road.
timeline.zh: 该省出资 1,750 万加元在马里亚实施海滩补沙，并在拉马特尔至马尔苏伊之间新建海堤，以保护这条公路。
